cases.name: AC-2 at most 2 decimal places
cases.detail: test_round_currency_has_at_most_two_decimals parametrized over all 18 inputs from AC-3..AC-8: -Decimal(str(result)).as_tuple().exponent <= 2 for every input (18/18 passed).

cases.name: AC-3 round-half-up on Decimal ties
cases.detail: round_currency(Decimal('2.345')) == Decimal('2.35'); round_currency(Decimal('2.335')) == Decimal('2.34'). Parametrized cases passed.

cases.name: AC-4 negative ties away from zero
cases.detail: round_currency(Decimal('-2.345')) == Decimal('-2.35'); round_currency(-2.345) == Decimal('-2.35'). Parametrized cases passed.

cases.name: AC-5 non-tie rounding
cases.detail: round_currency(2.344) == Decimal('2.34'); round_currency(2.346) == Decimal('2.35'); round_currency(-2.344) == Decimal('-2.34'). Parametrized cases passed.

cases.name: AC-6 float ties by decimal value
cases.detail: round_currency(2.345) == Decimal('2.35'); round_currency(1.005) == Decimal('1.01'); round_currency(0.125) == Decimal('0.13'); round_currency(2.675) == Decimal('2.68'). Parametrized cases passed.

cases.name: AC-7 padding and already-rounded values
cases.detail: round_currency(2.3) == Decimal('2.30'); round_currency(5) == Decimal('5.00'); round_currency(0) == Decimal('0.00'); round_currency(Decimal('19.99')) == Decimal('19.99'). Parametrized cases passed.

cases.name: AC-8 int/float/Decimal accepted
cases.detail: round_currency(7) == Decimal('7.00'); round_currency(7.005) == Decimal('7.01'); round_currency(Decimal('7.005')) == Decimal('7.01'); none raised.
